subject.title: feat(apple): copy or save rendered widgets as images from the chat transcript

question: Should OpenClaw support native copy/save PNG export actions directly on rendered Apple chat widgets?
rationale: This is a new user-facing transcript capability rather than a repair to an established broken contract, and the protected maintainer label requires explicit owner judgment on the permanent interaction surface.

options.title: Sponsor native export
options.body: Accept copy/save PNG export as an Apple transcript capability after real device or desktop proof verifies the intended menu behavior.

options.title: Narrow or defer the interaction
options.body: Keep export out of the widget context menu until a shared transcript-export design or a narrower Apple UX direction is chosen.

recommendation.title: Sponsor native export
recommendation.body: Accept copy/save PNG export as an Apple transcript capability after real device or desktop proof verifies the intended menu behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the proposed Apple implementation and can provide the concrete product and platform context needed for the decision.
